questions.q: What problem is investigated in the video's example?
o: Long lines for coffee in a café
questions.e: In the video: "Sedite u kafiću i gledate kako se stvara ogroman red... odlučujete da istražite ovaj problem".

questions.q: How many people need to be interviewed in the example?
questions.e: In the video: "pronađete 10 osoba sa kojima ćete da obavite intervju".

questions.q: What is an empathy map for?
o: To structure interview data and learn more from it
questions.e: In the video: "sada morate da nekako strukturirate ove podatke kako biste saznali nešto novo... mapa empatije".

questions.q: What are the four sections in the author's map?
questions.e: In the video: "Prva sekcija je „kaže“, druga sekcija je „misli“, treća sekcija je „radi“ i četvrta".

questions.q: How old is Sara Sarić, the interviewee, and where does she live?
questions.e: In the video: "Sara Sarić ima 27 godina, živi u velikom gradu, neka to bude Beograd".

questions.q: Why does Sara get coffee at Starbucks and not at the nearest café?
o: So she doesn't have to stand in line — she orders through the app
questions.e: In the video: "zašto ne ide u obližnji kafić, nego uzima kafu u Starbaksu, ona je rekla da onda neće čekati red".

questions.q: What is Sara still not fully happy about?
questions.e: In the video: "i dalje nije u potpunosti zadovoljna... Sara je takođe rekla da voli domaću kafu.".

questions.q: Do you need to make a separate empathy map for every user?
o: No, you can make one for a group of similar ones
questions.e: In the video: "Mapu empatije ne morate da kreirate za svakog korisnika posebno. Možete da izdvojite neke slične korisnike".

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Gledate kako se stvara ogroman *red*.
questions.e: Red — queue, order, row.

questions.q: Sa desne strane možete da vidite moje *beleške*.
questions.e: Beleška — a note; beležiti — to write down.

questions.q: Šta su to neka Sarina *uverenja*?
questions.e: Uverenje — belief, conviction.

questions.q: Mogli ste da *zaključite* na osnovu onoga što vam je rekla.
questions.e: Zaključiti — to draw a conclusion; zaključak — conclusion.

questions.q: Sara je *nestrpljiva*, zato što nema vremena da čeka.
questions.e: Nestrpljiv — impatient; strpljenje — patience.

questions.q: Ona pazi da ne *prospe* kafu.
questions.e: Prosuti — to spill, to scatter.

questions.q: Sara na posao ide *bajsom*.
questions.e: Bajs — colloquial for "bicycle".

questions.q: Ima *natrpan* raspored na poslu.
questions.e: Natrpan — crammed, overloaded.

questions.q: Sedite u ___ i gledate kako se stvara ogroman red.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u kafiću.

questions.q: Ko sve može da ima ovaj ___?
questions.e: Imati + object — accusative case; for inanimate masculine nouns it coincides with the nominative: problem.

questions.q: Onda, Sara je ___, zato što nema vremena da čeka u redu.
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the subject: Sara is feminine singular, so nestrpljiva.

questions.q: Mapu empatije možete da napravite na ___.
questions.e: Na in answer to "on what?" — locative case: na papiru.

questions.q: pokazaću vam na jednom ___ primeru.
questions.e: Na + locative. Primer is masculine, so the ending is -om: na jednom praktičnom primeru.

questions.q: Pored toga, ___ smo još neke nove zanimljive stvari.
questions.e: The result is that they found out something new: perfective saznali. Saznavali is imperfective. Smo is plural.

questions.q: Sara na posao ide ___.
questions.e: Ići + instrument (by what) — instrumental case: bajsom.

questions.q: Kupili biste mali set sticky ___.
questions.e: Set of what? Genitive plural: notova.
